searchText: Hi all, there will be extremely detailed post-mortem and retrospectives coming out this week, rest assured <@!183428997772738560> Looks like the block proposal problem is back on the menu saw that. from what we know, it will resolve at epoch 32576 beginning of next voting period prysm is also on the verge of a release until nodes update or move to other clients, we might see this issue intermittently since client diversity is again a hot buzzer issue and topic of conversation, i'd like to yet again raise what i said before. there needs to be a standard for metrics generated by the beacon chain and validator servies. this is one of the biggest hangups for anybody having one monitoring of their system to adopting another client it requires a rough change of whatever monitoring you're using and it makes moving between clients anything but seamless if your alerts in say grafana are based on certain keys that work in prysm, and lighthouse doesn't even produce anything close to those keys, you're basically shit out of luck to use both clients 50%/50% without some extra headache on your end to figure out how to adapt your alerting prysm/lighthouse are used as an example... search/replace those names with any two client names
